scooter_wont_start.title: Scooter will not start: safe owner checks
scooter_wont_start.safety: Park on level ground, keep the scooter on its centre stand if fitted, and do not keep pressing the starter near a fuel smell or visible leak. If there is a fuel leak, stop and call a mechanic.

steps.instruction: Turn the ignition on. Confirm the kill switch is in RUN and the side stand is fully up. Hold a brake lever, then try the starter once for no more than five seconds.
steps.check: The dash lights come on and the starter either cranks, clicks, or stays silent.

steps.instruction: If the horn is weak, lights dim badly, or you hear repeated clicks, stop retrying the starter. Open the battery access cover and check that both terminals are clean and firmly seated; do not bridge them with a tool.
steps.check: No loose terminal, white corrosion, swelling, crack, or liquid around the battery.

steps.instruction: If the dash is completely dark, switch the ignition off and inspect only the main fuse. Replace it only with the identical amperage printed on the old fuse.
steps.check: The replacement fuse remains intact when ignition is turned on.

steps.instruction: If the fuse blows again, the battery is swollen, or the scooter still will not crank with normal lights, stop here. The next checks need a mechanic or a battery tester.
steps.check: A service visit is booked instead of repeated starting attempts.

low_tyre_pressure.title: Tyre looks soft or loses air
low_tyre_pressure.safety: Do not ride on a visibly flat tyre, a tyre with sidewall damage, or a tyre showing cords. Keep fingers clear of the brake disc and do not loosen wheel or brake fasteners.

steps.instruction: Look over both tyre sidewalls and tread. If you see a cut, bulge, exposed cord, or a nail near the sidewall, stop and use a tyre shop—do not pull the object out.
steps.check: No sidewall damage or exposed cord is present.

steps.instruction: With the tyre cold, remove the valve cap and use a gauge. Inflate only to the front or rear pressure stated in this scooter's owner manual or tyre placard.
Put the cap back on. If it loses pressure again within a day, or you hear air escaping, ride no farther than necessary to a tyre shop.
steps.check: Pressure remains stable after rechecking later.

oil_level_check.title: Check engine-oil level
oil_level_check.safety: Check only with the engine cool, on level ground. Do not open any drain bolt or fill with an unknown oil grade.

steps.instruction: Park upright on level ground, switch the engine off, and wait until it is cool. Unscrew the dipstick, wipe it clean, then insert it exactly as this model's owner manual specifies before reading the level.
steps.check: Oil is between the marked limits and has no burnt smell or metal glitter.

steps.instruction: If it is below the lower mark, add only the owner-manual grade in very small amounts, rechecking each time. Do not overfill.
steps.check: Level is within the marked range, not above it.

steps.instruction: If the oil warning remains on, the oil is milky, smells burnt, or level falls again, stop riding and arrange service.
steps.check: A service visit is arranged for any persistent warning or leak.

headlamp_not_working.title: Headlamp does not turn on
headlamp_not_working.safety: Park safely and do not ride at night without a working headlamp. Stop immediately if wiring is hot, melted, or smells burnt.

steps.instruction: Turn the ignition on and cycle the light switch once. Check whether the horn and indicators still work; that tells you whether this is a single lamp fault or a wider electrical fault.
steps.check: You know whether other electrical items work normally.

steps.instruction: With ignition off, inspect the main lighting fuse only. Replace it only with the same amperage if it is visibly broken.
steps.check: The identical-rated replacement fuse remains intact.

steps.instruction: If the fuse is good but the headlamp remains off, use a mechanic for bulb and wiring diagnosis. Do not probe exposed wires or fit a higher-rated fuse.
steps.check: Night riding is avoided until the lamp works.
